verdict.rationale: Bento documents dedicated batch endpoints: POST /batch/subscribers bulk-creates or updates 1–1000 subscribers per request without triggering automations, and POST /batch/events tracks events in batches. The CLI supports CSV imports, and Bento Skills gives agents safety guidance specifically for bulk subscriber imports, so the AI-native path is covered. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond subscriber/event create-update (e.g., bulk tagging, deletion, or edits across other item types), evidence that the MCP server itself performs batch actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
